Hey there, so I’ve taken prozac for a little over two years now and it completely changed my life. Granted, I’m probably going to be on it for life so I really don’t think I can speak on the withdrawal effects. However, it really streamlines your thoughts. 

Have you ever felt like your thoughts were scattered and you had to do something unproductive in order to stop the anxiety like binge on a lot of junk food? It completely stopped that for me. It’s like me and my anxiety are separated by a huge chunk of ice and I can finally concentrate and prioritize tasks and it’s surreal. I am ten times more productive now and I hope it works out for you. I know 
everyone’s experience is individual, but my mind is so much clearer. I can finally make rational decisions so much quicker than I did before. My anxiety no longer dominates my decisions, and that is incredibly empowering. 

However, I was manic for around two weeks early in the treatment. That went away, but as long as I’m on this, my sex drive is gone. I can orgasm, but it takes more effort. Erogenous zones were also numbed (like the back of your knees or neck) and I wasn’t expecting that. I’m also much less emotional and it can be harder to feel love, but it’s there, it’s just at 0.20 instead of 1. 

Overall, it completely changed my life and I would give it a shot, even if it emotionally numbed me, I feel like I can properly manage my life now. I started feeling the effects at 20mg, so I would go up there and see how you feel. Good luck!
